paths.description: Homepage and primary news-discovery surface; tested desktop, 360x800, dark/reduced-motion/high-contrast, performance, network, security, accessibility and memory.
Zprávy section/listing template, representing editorial category listings.
Current news article/detail and primary reading task; tested desktop, mobile, discoverability, images and Lighthouse.
Sign-in/account entry form, representing the authentication journey.
Intentional missing URL, representing HTTP error and recovery behavior.

findings.summary: The site ignores the user’s dark color-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: Under emulated prefers-color-scheme: dark, the body remained rgb(255,255,255) with color-scheme: normal; the dark-condition screenshot is visually identical to light mode.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide preference-driven dark surface/text tokens using prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: News pages ship a fixed 1030px desktop viewport instead of a mobile layout.
findings.evidence: At a 360x800 device viewport, layout metrics report innerWidth/clientWidth 1030 and visual scale 0.3495 because meta viewport is width=1030; the full desktop page is miniaturised and text/actions become extremely small.
findings.suggestedFix: Use width=device-width, initial-scale=1 and replace fixed-width page shells with fluid/intrinsic layouts that reflow at narrow widths.

findings.summary: Reusable news components do not adapt to their available container.
findings.evidence: The platform probe found no container rules, while 360px captures preserve the full desktop two-column layout at 0.35 scale rather than adapting cards/navigation to the narrow container.
findings.suggestedFix: Introduce container-type on reusable regions and size-aware @container rules, alongside a fluid page shell.

findings.summary: Many interactive targets are below the recommended touch size.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed target-size and the target probe found the 34x34 sign-in control and many navigation links only 34px high.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase target boxes/spacing to at least 44 CSS px where practical, retain visible :focus-visible styles, and provide non-hover access to submenus.

findings.summary: Advertising dominates the first viewport before editorial content.
findings.evidence: Desktop screenshots show a full-width ad occupying about 230px of a 493px viewport before the masthead; the article headline begins below another similarly dominant ad.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve a smaller, stable ad slot, defer non-critical ad chrome, and prioritise masthead/headline/editorial content in the first viewport.

findings.summary: Cold-load performance is poor on the homepage and article.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured homepage LCP 10.08s, FCP 5.27s, TBT 337ms and performance 0.48; the article measured LCP 4.64s and performance 0.59.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the LCP resource, defer non-critical ads/scripts/styles, and split blocking work until mobile LCP is under 2.5s and interactions remain responsive.

findings.summary: The article has severe layout shift and many images lack reserved dimensions.
findings.evidence: Article Lighthouse CLS was 0.298; image audits found 28 article and 36 homepage images missing dimensions.
findings.suggestedFix: Set width/height or aspect-ratio for every content/ad image and reserve deterministic space for late ad and font content.

findings.summary: The homepage ships substantial unused JavaScript and blocking work.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported about 1.46MB potentially unused JavaScript and 337ms TBT; scripts transferred 1.96MB in the HAR.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unused bundles, conditionally load advertising/account integrations, split long work, and lower non-critical script priority.

findings.summary: The critical path is crowded by styles and ad scripts.
findings.evidence: HAR captured 258 requests and 3.82MB, including seven VeryHigh parser-inserted stylesheets and parser-inserted ad/site scripts; Lighthouse’s separate run saw 365 requests and 5.70MB.
findings.suggestedFix: Consolidate critical CSS, defer non-critical styles/scripts, ensure scripts are async/defer/module where safe, and delay ad auctions until after core content.

findings.summary: Unused code and third-party code dominate the load.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 1.46MB unused JS and 72KB unused CSS; HAR’s largest files are ad-tech bundles, GPT, GTM and prebid.
findings.suggestedFix: Use coverage-driven bundle removal and load third-party code only on pages/interactions that need it.

findings.summary: Important images, links, frames and form inputs lack robust accessible names.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed image-alt, link-name and frame-title; the homepage image audit found 36 missing alts, and the sign-in probe found email/password controls with no associated label.
findings.suggestedFix: Add meaningful alt text, accessible link/frame names, and persistent programmatic labels for account fields.

findings.summary: Some text and controls fail minimum color contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse’s color-contrast audit failed on the homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust foreground/background tokens to WCAG contrast minimums and verify both default and high-contrast conditions.

findings.summary: Page structure does not provide a reliable heading and landmark hierarchy.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed heading-order and landmark-one-main; homepage recon exposed no main element and an empty h1, while some unnamed links remain focusable.
findings.suggestedFix: Add one main landmark, a descriptive h1, sequential headings, and remove or name empty focusable links.

findings.summary: Mobile text is miniaturised rather than reflowed.
findings.evidence: The 360px screenshot renders the 1030px desktop canvas at 0.3495 scale, making body copy and navigation too small for comfortable reading.
findings.suggestedFix: Adopt a device-width viewport and fluid type/line lengths that reflow without requiring pinch zoom.

findings.summary: The viewport configuration defeats normal mobile reflow.
findings.evidence: meta viewport is width=1030 on all sampled news templates, and Lighthouse also failed target-size.
findings.suggestedFix: Use width=device-width, permit user scaling, test reflow at 320 CSS px and 200% zoom, and enlarge touch targets.

findings.summary: The homepage logs application errors.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse captured two console.error messages from paticka.js for missing infinite-ad position elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Guard ad-slot initialisation when its target is absent and remove expected-state console errors.

findings.summary: Image/document asset hygiene is weak.
findings.evidence: The image audit found 36 images without dimensions, 29 oversized images, 77 without srcset and 90 legacy-format images on the homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit correct intrinsic dimensions, responsive sources and modern formats while preserving useful alt text.

findings.summary: The page triggers deprecated API, inspector and BFCache problems.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed deprecations, inspector-issues and bf-cache on the homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove deprecated API use, resolve DevTools issues, and eliminate unload/state patterns that block BFCache.

findings.summary: The page is not mobile-friendly and some links are not crawlable.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed crawlable-anchors, and the viewport is hard-coded to width=1030; robots allows ordinary search crawlers but this page-level markup undermines mobile discovery.
findings.suggestedFix: Use real href links with descriptive text and a device-width viewport.

findings.summary: Transport is HTTPS, but key security headers and cookie flags are missing.
findings.evidence: The headers primitive found no CSP, HSTS or nosniff. Cookie audit found 13 cookies with issues, including sso_sync and g_state without Secure and many SameSite=None cookies.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive CSP, HSTS and nosniff; minimise SameSite=None and mark every HTTPS cookie Secure, with HttpOnly for session credentials.

findings.summary: The page has an exceptionally broad tracking and ad-tech footprint.
findings.evidence: Tracker evidence found 57 third-party origins and 11 known trackers; HAR attributed 253 of 258 requests and 3.76MB to origins other than www.idnes.cz (including CDN subdomains and ad vendors).
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce vendors, gate non-essential tracking on explicit consent, batch analytics, and document/justify each retained third party.

findings.summary: The sign-in flow does not expose passkey authentication or standard credential autocomplete.
findings.evidence: The login page offers passwords and federated/bank identity options, but its email/password controls have empty autocomplete tokens and no passkey action was observed.
findings.suggestedFix: Add autocomplete=username/current-password and offer WebAuthn passkeys with the existing recovery/federated options.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced defensive policies are absent.
findings.evidence: The response has no clickjacking defense, Referrer-Policy or Permissions-Policy, in addition to missing CSP/HSTS.
findings.suggestedFix: Set CSP frame-ancestors (or X-Frame-Options), Referrer-Policy and a least-privilege Permissions-Policy; consider Trusted Types for XSS-sensitive account surfaces.

findings.summary: An article’s core content is not reliably available to a no-JavaScript crawler.
findings.evidence: Discoverability captured only 7% raw/rendered word overlap for the article, classified it as a JS shell, and observed a consent-settings redirect; the homepage reached 92%.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render article title, dek and body independent of JavaScript/consent UI, and make consent an enhancement that does not replace core public content.

findings.summary: Sign-in fields omit autocomplete and persistent labels.
findings.evidence: The login probe reports empty autocomplete on email and password inputs and no associated label elements; placeholders are the only visible field instruction.
findings.suggestedFix: Add persistent labels plus autocomplete=username and current-password, preserving password-manager and assistive-technology support.

findings.summary: Most images use legacy formats and lack responsive delivery.
findings.evidence: Homepage images audit found 90 legacy-format images, 77 without srcset, 29 oversized and 28 below-fold images not lazy-loaded.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate AVIF/WebP responsive sources, size them to display density, and lazy-load non-critical images.

findings.summary: Background advertising and analytics create substantial avoidable work.
findings.evidence: HAR captured 90 xhr/fetch requests and 35 scripts; the tracker scan found 57 third-party origins, with auctions and sync endpoints active during initial load.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer auctions/analytics until consent and idle time, batch events, and remove redundant sync/fetch activity.

findings.summary: Third-party bytes are disproportionate to the editorial experience.
findings.evidence: HAR reports 3.76MB of 3.82MB transferred from origins other than www.idnes.cz and multiple large ad-tech bundles; Lighthouse’s run transferred 5.70MB.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party byte/request budget, self-host first-party assets where appropriate, and defer or remove vendors that do not improve the reading task.

findings.summary: Repeated infinite-feed traversal grows the retained page footprint sharply.
findings.evidence: After ten bottom/top traversals, heap nodes rose from 648,617 to 934,976 and self size from 38.3MB to 66.9MB; an in-page sample saw DOM elements rise from 1,989 to 10,891.
findings.suggestedFix: Virtualise or cap appended feed/ad nodes, release observers/listeners and cached payloads when sections leave the active window, then repeat the same heap comparison.

taskList.title: Replace the fixed 1030px mobile viewport with true responsive/reflowing layouts
Cut initial ad-tech, tracking, request and unused-script cost
Add complete security headers and tighten cookies
Reserve image/ad space and modernise responsive image delivery
Repair accessible names, landmarks, headings, contrast and touch targets
Server-render article content independently of consent JavaScript
Cap or virtualise infinite-feed DOM and retained heap growth
Add sign-in labels, autocomplete and passkeys
Resolve console, deprecated API, inspector and BFCache defects
